name: app.vercel.warstwa-omega/docs-mcp
title: Warstwa: dokumenty i pomoc
description: Read-only Warstwa docs: terms, returns, delivery, privacy and help answers.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Use to answer questions about Warstwa's rules: returns and 14-day withdrawal, complaints, delivery and payment, privacy, terms, personalisation and care. Searches the legal documents and help answers (Polish) and returns matching documents.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Use after search_docs or list_docs to read one document in full before quoting it. Returns the title, the full Polish text (unfilled seller data appears as DO UZUPEŁNIENIA) and its public URL.

id.description: Document id from search_docs or list_docs, e.g. 'prawne/regulamin'

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: Use to see every document this server can return: the shop's legal documents and answered help questions, with ids for get_doc and public URLs.
